title: An OS command Injection issue exists in Air Terminal 6 provided by SoftBank Corp. (CVE-2026-101107)
description: An OS command injection vulnerability exists in Air Terminal 6 by SoftBank Corp. This flaw allows an authenticated user with access to the web management console to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.0. No affected versions or patch information are currently provided.
